ed-d-mame.title: Most golds won
ed-d-mame.caption: Names the zombies, jokes at the worst moment, volunteers first, and walks into the abandoned building. We will miss you, Ed.

heather.title: Biggest landslide
heather.caption: Thirteen of you saw the chaos and said "her." Brave.

emmi.title: Adopts every stray
emmi.caption: Yes, including the one that is definitely the villain.
